ABOUT THE LEAGUE

Welcome to VORNIXER

VORNIXER is a fast-paced cricket league where every match consists of just 20 legal deliveries (3.2 overs) per innings. Every ball matters, every decision counts, and every player has the opportunity to change the game.

01

Match Format

  • 20 balls (3.2 overs) per innings
  • 2 teams
  • One innings per team
  • Highest score wins
  • No time to settle — attack from ball one
02

Team Composition

Each team consists of 5 players or more

  • 1 Captain
  • 1 Vice-Captain
  • 3+ Players
03

Bowling Rules

  • Every bowler can bowl a maximum of 5 deliveries
  • A team may use up to 4 bowlers
  • Captains can change the bowler after any ball, allowing complete tactical flexibility
04

Batting Rules

  • Batters may retire only if injured
  • Standard dismissals apply — Bowled, Caught, Run Out, LBW, Stumped, Hit Wicket, etc.
  • Every run is valuable because of the limited number of deliveries

Why VORNIXER?

With only 20 balls available, there is:

No slow starts No recovery time No wasted deliveries Every decision can decide the match
05

Team Sheet

Squad size — 5 players or more

  1. Captain
  2. Vice-Captain
  3. Player 3
  4. Player 4
  5. Player 5
06

Match Officials

  • 1 Scorer (one of the players)
